how much time will it take
It will take around 2-3 hours to make the homemade pizza, including the time for the dough to rise (1-2 hours) and the actual preparation and baking time (30-45 minutes).

The ingredients for the homemade pizza are:

1. 2 cups of warm water
2. 2 teaspoons of sugar
3. 1 tablespoon of active dry yeast
4. 3 1/2 cups of all-purpose flour
5. 1 teaspoon of salt
6. 2 tablespoons of olive oil
7. 1 cup of pizza sauce
8. 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese
9. Toppings of your choice (e.g. pepperoni, bell peppers, onions, mushrooms)
